verdict.rationale: Thoropass explicitly supports multi-framework compliance from a single platform, with dedicated pages for GDPR and PCI DSS alongside SOC 2/ISO, unified controls mapped across frameworks, and cross-framework task/dashboard views (docs-12, docs-13, docs-14, docs-27, docs-37, docs-40, docs-50, docs-51). HIPAA is referenced via Unified Control mapping to HIPAA framework controls (docs-14). Missing for 10: explicit named coverage of HIPAA as a first-class framework page/dashboard like GDPR/PCI, and independent customer corroboration of running multiple disparate frameworks simultaneously without added tools.
